1.explanation:
1. Create a file named `hello-percent.qmd` with the provided YAML header specifying `width: "100%"` and `height: "100%"` under `format: revealjs`.
2. Run `quarto render hello-percent.qmd --to revealjs --output hello-percent.html`.
3. Open the generated `hello-percent.html` in a browser. You should see a blank/black screen instead of the slides.

By contrast, changing the header to pixel values (e.g. `width: 1600` and `height: 900`) will render the slides correctly. This minimal example reproduces the unquoted-percent bug in the Quarto revealjs template.
1.bug_scenario: When a Quarto revealjs presentation is configured to use percentage values for its slide width and height (e.g. width: "100%" and height: "100%"), the generated HTML template injects unquoted percentage values into the Reveal.js initialization. This results in an invalid configuration and a blank (black) screen instead of the rendered slides, as seen in the first screenshot. When pixel values are used instead (e.g. width: 1600, height: 900), the presentation renders correctly, as shown in the second screenshot.
